culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Interests in the STEM field, academic study life, high-paying job success, wealth, professionalism, maintaining the status quo, social democracy/liberalism

visualDNA.colour: Any colors, such as red, green, brown, blue and grey particularly

fashion.Overview: Nerds don't have a specific style that is always followed, although anything which aligns with typically nerdy interests will make the look instantly nerdier. Any math, physics, science or nerdy interest-based clothing seems nerdy, even without the stereotypical glasses. Although being a nerd doesn't tend to have a specific look, they generally won't look trendy or extremely fashionable, unless nerdy fashion has come into the mainstream for a bit. The general look is usually seem as a shirt and tie or nerdy T-shirt and jeans, but there really isn't any specific guidelines to follow to look nerdy. However, nerds are rarely seen without wearing their glasses.

activities: Playing board games (especially chess and Dungeons & Dragons)
Studying math and science for a magnet school
Running for class president at school
Reading about politics and political implications
